target.title: improve(agents): tail-load compacted session transcripts on startup
target.body:
Closes #99190

AI-assisted: yes. I reviewed the change and understand the runtime behavior.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where embedded attempt startup could fully read and parse long-running session transcript JSONL files even after compaction summarized the active replay path.

## Why This Change Was Made

`SessionManager.openCompactedTail()` now takes an opt-in bounded tail path for current-version transcripts larger than 32 MiB when the tail proves a complete compacted replay boundary. Rewrite paths force a full reload first so historical transcript data is not lost during header normalization or trailing-entry rewrites.

## User Impact

Caps the hot startup read to 2 MiB for eligible compacted transcripts while preserving full-fidelity parsing for migration, repair, rewrite, truncation, and normal inspection paths.

## Evidence

- New regression fixture covers a transcript larger than 32 MiB with 1,005 full entries; the tail opener loads the compacted replay suffix and header/trailing-entry rewrites preserve the large prefix.
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/agents/sessions/session-manager.ts src/agents/sessions/session-manager.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/session-manager-init.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.ts` -> passed
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/sessions/session-manager.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.session-lock.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/session-manager-init.test.ts` -> 1 shard, 179 tests passed
- `git diff --check` -> passed

Signed-off-by: Ho Lim <subhoya@gmail.com>
